title: Braised Short Ribs (Cabernet)
description: Bone-in short ribs seared in bacon fat, then slowly braised in red wine and beef broth with aromatics and herbs until they fall off the bone in a glossy, deep sauce.
watch: Check bacon and beef broth are gluten-free

title: Rack of Lamb with Dijon Herb Crust
description: Frenched lamb racks slathered in Dijon, garlic, lemon zest and a thick coat of fresh rosemary, thyme and parsley, then roasted to a rosy medium-rare. Impressive but fast.

title: Slow Cooker Pot Roast
description: Chuck roast cooked low and slow with potatoes, carrots, celery, red wine and herbs, with the juices thickened by cornstarch into a silky gravy.
watch: Check beef broth is gluten-free

title: 30-Minute Dairy-Free Creamy Tuscan Chicken
description: Thin chicken strips in a coconut-milk cream sauce with sun-dried tomatoes, garlic and Italian herbs, tossed with gluten-free spaghetti. Written to be top-8 allergen free.
swaps: Use gluten-free spaghetti (as the recipe specifies); use full-fat coconut milk or a nut-free plant cream (not cashew/almond)
watch: Contains coconut; check chicken bouillon is gluten-free

title: Baked Honey Mustard Chicken & Potatoes
description: Seasoned chicken breasts and potato chunks roasted together and brushed with a sweet three-mustard honey glaze. A hands-off, kid-friendly one-pan supper.
watch: Check seasoned salt and mustards are gluten-free (avoid malt-vinegar mustards)

title: 30-Minute Sweet and Sour Chicken Stir Fry
description: Better-than-takeout stir fry: chicken, peppers, zucchini and pineapple in a tangy ketchup-vinegar sauce, served over rice with sesame seeds.
swaps: Use gluten-free tamari for the soy sauce
watch: Check ketchup is gluten-free

title: Easy Gluten-Free Chicken Piccata
description: Thin chicken cutlets dredged in cornstarch, pan-fried, and finished in a bright lemon, garlic and caper pan sauce. The classic, made gluten- and dairy-free.
swaps: Use a nut-free dairy-free butter (or olive oil); omit the dairy-free Parmesan or use a nut-free brand (many are cashew-based)
watch: Check chicken broth is gluten-free

title: Turkey Bolognese with Gluten-Free Fusilli
description: Ground turkey simmered with onion, garlic, thyme and bay leaves in tomato sauce, tossed with gluten-free fusilli and fresh basil. Simple family pasta night.
swaps: Use gluten-free pasta (as written); omit the dairy-free Parmesan or use a nut-free brand
watch: Check jarred pasta sauce has no cheese or wheat

title: 1-Pot Chickpea Shakshuka
description: An egg-free take on shakshuka: chickpeas simmered in a smoky, warmly spiced tomato and red pepper sauce, finished with olives and lemon.
swaps: Serve with rice or gluten-free bread rather than regular bread/flatbread

title: 1-Pot Red Lentil Chili
description: A thick, hearty vegan chili with red lentils, kidney and black beans, peppers and corn in a smoky chili-cumin tomato base. Great for batch cooking.
swaps: Skip the linked vegan 'cheese' Fritos topping (it may contain nuts); top with avocado and cilantro instead
watch: Check chili powder blend is gluten-free

title: Spicy Red Lentil Curry
description: Red lentils simmered in a red curry, tomato and ginger sauce with a splash of coconut milk, served over rice with pickled onion and cilantro.
swaps: Omit the pita/naan; serve over rice
watch: If using store-bought Thai curry paste, pick a shellfish-free one (e.g. Thai Kitchen); many Thai brands (Maesri, Mae Ploy) contain shrimp paste; contains coconut (oil and milk)

title: A Really Good Slow Cooker Beef Stew
description: Chuck beef braised for hours in red wine and stock with carrots, celery and baby potatoes until meltingly tender, with a rich, thick gravy.
swaps: Use the gluten-free flour option (recipe Note 1) or cornstarch instead of plain flour; use gluten-free Worcestershire (e.g. Lea & Perrins US)
watch: Check stock and stock cube are gluten-free

title: Chimichurri Steak
description: Quick-seared flank, skirt or flat iron steak, sliced and spooned with a punchy fresh parsley, oregano, garlic and red wine vinegar chimichurri.

title: Carne Asada
description: Skirt or flank steak marinated in orange, lime, cilantro, jalapeño and garlic, then charred hot and fast and sliced for tacos.
swaps: Use corn tortillas (labeled gluten-free) instead of flour tortillas

title: Eggless Meatballs
description: Juicy beef (or beef-pork) meatballs held together with arrowroot instead of egg or breadcrumbs. Simmer in your favorite marinara or broth.
watch: If finishing in sauce, check jarred marinara has no cheese; check broth is gluten-free

title: Creamy Vegan Mushroom Risotto
description: Arborio rice stirred slowly with vegetable stock, two kinds of mushrooms, thyme and lemon zest until naturally creamy, without any cream or cheese.
swaps: Use a nut-free vegan butter (or olive oil) for the finishing butter
watch: Check vegetable stock is gluten-free

title: Sheet Pan Lemon-Herb Salmon with Asparagus
description: Salmon fillets and asparagus roasted together under a lemon, garlic, thyme and parsley olive-oil dressing. Dinner in 20 minutes with one pan to wash.

title: Sheet Pan Maple Dijon Salmon
description: Maple-Dijon-rosemary glazed salmon roasted alongside caramelized sweet potatoes and Brussels sprouts on a single sheet pan.

title: Sheet Pan Blueberry Salmon
description: Salmon and Brussels sprouts roasted with a jammy blueberry, balsamic and basil topping. Pretty enough for guests and easy enough for a weeknight.

title: Tofu Jalfrezi
description: Pan-seared tofu tossed with charred onion and bell peppers in a smoky, tangy tomato-spice masala with cumin, coriander and fenugreek.

title: Baked Tofu Curry (Tofu Makhani)
description: A mostly hands-off vegan 'butter tofu': tofu, aromatics and spices baked in a creamy tomato and coconut milk sauce until rich and thick.
swaps: Use the coconut milk option, not the cashew milk alternative
watch: Contains coconut

title: Easy Harissa Chicken
description: Chicken pressure-cooked (or slow-cooked) with bell peppers, garlic, paprika, cumin and harissa into a smoky, spicy shreddable stew. Serve over rice.
swaps: Skip the optional 'creamy herb sauce' topping (it may be egg- or nut-based); serve with capers and lemon instead
watch: Contains coconut (coconut aminos); check harissa and chicken broth labels

title: Ropa Vieja
description: Cuban-style shredded chuck roast cooked with peppers, onion, tomatoes, cumin, oregano and green olives in the Instant Pot or slow cooker.
swaps: Use the coconut oil option (or olive oil) instead of ghee
watch: If using coconut oil, it is coconut; check beef broth is gluten-free

title: Pork Tenderloin with Apples
description: Pork tenderloin roasted with apples, onion and Brussels sprouts in a whole-grain mustard, balsamic and rosemary glaze. Autumn on a sheet pan.
watch: Check whole-grain mustard is gluten-free

title: Salsa Pork Chops
description: Five-ingredient slow-cooker pork chops simmered in salsa, onion and taco seasoning until they shred easily. Use in tacos, bowls or over rice.
watch: Check taco seasoning and salsa are gluten-free

title: Roast Chicken with Herb Butter
description: Cut-up chicken rubbed with thyme, rosemary, sage, shallot and lemon zest and roasted over shallots and garlic, with a Dijon pan sauce from the drippings.
swaps: Make the 'herb butter' with a nut-free dairy-free butter or olive oil instead of butter; finish the pan sauce with olive oil or DF butter
watch: Check chicken broth is gluten-free

title: Grilled Chimichurri Chicken Thighs
description: Boneless thighs marinated and grilled with a herb-heavy chimichurri of parsley, cilantro, mint, shallot and sherry vinegar, with extra sauce for drizzling.

title: Baked Cod with Fennel and Tomatoes
description: Lemon-thyme cod fillets baked on a bed of onion, fennel, cherry tomatoes, garlic and capers until the vegetables are soft and saucy.
watch: Check vegetable broth is gluten-free

title: Easy Lentil Shepherd's Pie (Vegan)
description: Lentils and mixed vegetables in a savory thyme-rosemary tomato filling, topped with fluffy mashed potatoes. Written by an allergy-focused blogger.
swaps: Use a nut-free vegan butter and a non-nut milk (oat certified GF, soy, rice or hemp) in the mash
watch: Contains coconut (coconut aminos)

title: Baked Hamburgers
description: Egg-free beef patties seasoned with garlic, mustard and hot sauce and baked on a sheet pan, an easy way to make burgers for a crowd.
swaps: Use gluten-free Worcestershire (e.g. Lea & Perrins US); serve on gluten-free buns or lettuce wraps
watch: Check mustard and hot sauce labels

title: Thai Yellow Chicken Curry with Potatoes
description: Chicken and baby potatoes simmered in a mellow, golden coconut curry sauce, served over jasmine rice with cilantro.
watch: If using store-bought Thai curry paste, pick a shellfish-free one (e.g. Thai Kitchen); many Thai brands (Maesri, Mae Ploy) contain shrimp paste; contains coconut; check fish sauce is gluten-free (some brands add wheat)

title: Slow Cooker Chicken Curry
description: Chicken thighs, sweet potato and red peppers slow-cooked in a smoky curry-spiced coconut sauce brightened with lime.
watch: Contains coconut

title: 20-Minute Gluten-Free Mongolian Beef
description: Thin-sliced flank steak seared crisp and tossed with broccoli and scallions in a glossy tamari, ginger and maple glaze. Takeout at home.
watch: Use gluten-free tamari as specified; contains coconut oil (avocado oil works too)

title: Roasted Duck Breast with Cherry Relish
description: Crisp-skinned duck breasts paired with a quick relish of rum- or cognac-soaked dried cherries and fresh basil. A short ingredient list with dinner-party payoff.

title: Sheet Pan Chicken Fajitas
description: Chicken strips, three colors of peppers and onion roasted with a homemade chili-cumin-coriander rub, finished with lime and cilantro.
swaps: Use corn tortillas (labeled gluten-free) instead of flour tortillas; skip sour cream and cheese, top with avocado/guacamole and tomatoes
